identity_reason: a spacer is empty space; it has no form to derive
concept: Space with no content, either a step from the gap scale or all the free space, so spacing stays a gap and never a margin.

root.why: empty space that is never content, so the layout reads the same everywhere it is used

grow.why: takes the free space in a row so what follows sits at the far end

s-xs.why: a fixed step from the gap scale (xs)

s-sm.why: a fixed step from the gap scale (sm)

s-md.why: a fixed step from the gap scale (md)

s-lg.why: a fixed step from the gap scale (lg)

s-xl.why: a fixed step from the gap scale (xl)

s-2xl.why: a fixed step from the gap scale (2xl)
